title: OTHRYS OS Apps and Integrations inventory
goal: Expose proven connected surfaces as a read-only Apps and Integrations inventory before any integration action authority exists.
laws: Only integrations backed by existing V2 evidence may appear as proven.
No connect, disconnect, OAuth, credential, shell or network action is added.
Secrets, tokens and raw credentials never enter status JSON.
Local and remote surfaces are visibly distinguished.
Unavailable or gated integrations must not look active.
Any future integration action requires a separate authority mission.

slices.title: Expose Apps navigation and read-only cards
Prove no integration action endpoint exists
